payload.name: ExtractDirectActionSuggestions
payload.description: When one speaker directly suggests a concrete action for another person, create a memory candidate during extraction; do not skip brief or casual advice.
content: During extraction, generate a candidate whenever a speaker directly tells another person to perform a concrete action, even if the message is short or informal; record the suggested action, the target person, and the speaker.
During CRUD, ADD the suggestion as a compact event or plan memory linked to the source message and timestamp; do not invent details beyond the visible text.

solves: Construction pipelines sometimes skip direct suggestions when the message is brief or phrased as casual advice. The diagnosed failure was that no candidate was generated for a speaker recommending a concrete action to another person. This rule abstracts that mechanism because suggestions recur across topics and should be stored regardless of surface content. It applies to future sessions where one interlocutor directly advises another to take a concrete action, ensuring the fact is available for later questions. It does not apply to unstated intentions or general praise.
